lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are arranged in roughly vertical columns along the mid-lateral flank; vertical inter-spot distance is approximately 1.5 times the mean spot diameter, with rows following the longitudinal axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of white spots, forming a grid-like topology where spots are localized within the lighter vertical bands.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp intensity transition from light-gray on the upper edge to dark-gray shadow on the lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a sparse distribution of small, discrete high-luminance blobs, with approximately 8-12 spots visible on the lateral surface, primarily located near the base and trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable tissue loss and jagged irregularities are visible along the posterior (trailing) edge of the upper lobe of the caudal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A remora (Echeneidae) is clearly visible attached to the ventral surface of the shark's caudal peduncle area.
